verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is an API-first service that needs only an API key and a URL per request, so it runs headlessly by design. An official CLI covers scraping, crawling, exports and cron-based schedules, which suits scripted and CI automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline guidance (e.g., GitHub Actions examples, env-var key handling, exit-code behavior), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
